description.value:
You know the @Compendium[undertaking.spells-cantrips.NTGJ71IJ1VDA3GS9]{Luminescence} cantrip. The light you cast with this spell resembles moonlight, and its brightness is determined by your Lunar Cycle phase.

  • New Moon phase: Your @Compendium[undertaking.spells-cantrips.NTGJ71IJ1VDA3GS9]{Luminescence} cantrip only sheds 30 feet of dim light.
  • Full Moon phase: Your @Compendium[undertaking.spells-cantrips.NTGJ71IJ1VDA3GS9]{Luminescence} cantrip only sheds 30 feet of bright light.
